customAnimations.name: riseGlow
customAnimations.keyframes: @keyframes riseGlow { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(36px) scale(0.96); filter: blur(6px) } 60% { opacity: 1; filter: blur(0px) } 100% { opacity: 1; transform: none; filter: none } }

customAnimations.name: popIn
customAnimations.keyframes: @keyframes popIn { 0%, 20% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.6) } 80%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) } }
